Other than these terms and conditions, bidder will be rejected if not submitting any document which is mentioned in the Bid document. 42) Specifications for C-Arm Fluroscope X-Ray machine General Requirements a) A mobile C Arm image intensifier required for use in Orthopaedic, Urology, Neurology, Gastrointestinal, Vascular, Pain Management, General Surgery and suitable for veterinary use. b) All components must comply with Indian regulatory and safety standards. 2. Mechanical motion specifications (C-Arm) a. Motorized vertical travel should be 400 mm or more. b. Pivotal rotation / swivel range should be ±12.5° or more. c. Arc orbital movement should be 120° (−30° to +90°) or better. d. Horizontal movement should be 200 mm or more. e. Source-to-Image Intensifier distance (SID) should be 960 mm or more. f. Free space between image intensifier and X-ray tube should be 760 mm or more. g. Rotation of C-Arm should be ±180° or more. h. Arc depth of C-Arm should be 630 mm or more. i. The C-Arm should have a foot lock facility. j. Mechanical locks for all movements must be provided. 3. X-ray generator and control panel a. The X-ray generator should be a high-frequency generator of minimum b. 50 kHz or more. c. Generator power output should be 3.5 kW or more. d. Operating voltage range should be 40 kV to 110 kV. e. Continuous fluoroscopy current range should be 0.1 to 3 mA. f. The X-ray tube should have focal spots minimum of 0.6 mm² for fluoroscopy and 1.5 mm² for radiogra phy. g. Anode heat storage capacity should be 40 KHU or more. h. Boosted / High-definition fluoroscopy current should be of minimum 7.0 mA or more. i. Console should display real-time tube head temperature with bar graph indicator. j. Radiography capacity should be 200 mAs or more. k. Radiography mA should be 70 mA or more. l. X-ray exposure initiation should be possible through both foot switch and hand-held switch. m. Unit must have a 7-inch or higher full touch digital GUI control panel. n. Manual and automatic (KV/mA) selection modes must be available.

o. All fluoroscopic and radiographic parameters including KV, mA, time, mode, magnification, and tube te mperature should be displayed on the panel. p. Unit must have cumulative timer (~5 min) with buzzer should be provided. q. Emergency stop switch must be provided. r. Anatomical program radiography modes should be included. s. The X-ray generator should be of indigenous make if the generator is imported from other country, co mplete specifications of datasheet from the principal manufacture with an undertaking from them stati ng spares/parts of the generator would be available for the next 10 years to be attached with the bid. 4. Imaging system (Image intensifier & camera) a. Image intensifier should be a triple-field of 9”/6”/4.5”. b. X-ray grid shall be 10:1, 100 lines. c. TV camera should be a compact CMOS/CCD type with 1024 × 1024 pixels or more. d. Modular trolley should include a minimum of 27-inch single monitor/dual screen monitor of minimum 1 9-inch. e. System should support image rotation without exposure. 5. Digital imaging and processing features a. System should include a PC-based full digital image memory module. b. Subject registration should include subject details, procedure details, doctor name, date and time. c. Display information should include subject ID, name, age, hospital name, operating modes, rotation an d KV/mA in values. d. Real-time brightness and contrast adjustment should be available. e. Last Image Hold - should hold the last image on the screen after every procedure during fluoroscopy a nd have sequential numbering. f. Virtual Collimation - Alignment and adjustment of X-ray field with image available on the monitor. g. Permanent image storage capacity should be 2,00,000 images or more. h. Image rotation capability should be ±180° in 1° increments. i. Image orientation controls: Left/right flip and top/bottom flip. j. Negative image (grey-level inversion) should be available. k. Image averaging (2, 4, 6, 8, 12, 16) should be provided. l. Real-time edge enhancement must be included. m. Manual and auto-save options for images should be available. n. Reference monitor function should allow transfer of live image to reference screen. o. Multiple display formats: Single, Quad, Nine, and Sixteen image views. p. Cine loop acquisition rates: 1, 2, 4, 8, 15, 25 fps. q. Cine loop playback: Play, pause, stop and frame-by-frame. r. Thumbnail view for stored images and cine loops. s. Post-processing filters: Sharpening, Mean, Median. t. Edge detection feature must be included. u. Zoom in/out and pan functionality.

v. Measurement and annotation tools should be available. 6. Data documentation and export a. Software should support subject report generation. b. USB export facility should be included. c. DVD writing/burning capability should be available. d. Seamless connectivity: DICOM 3.0 along with connectivity accessories will be preferred. 7. Power Requirements Power input should be 230V ±10%, 50 Hz The bidder shall provide all accessories and other electrical requirements necessary for installation and commissioning of the equipment at no additional cost. 8. Supporting accessories a. The unit must be supplied with AERB-approved lightweight lead aprons (5 No.s), lead goggles (5 No.s), gonadal shields (5 No.s), and thyroid shields (5 No.s). With floor mounted stand for lead aprons. b. The unit must be supplied with a Desktop equipped with an i7 processor or higher, operating at ≥2.1 G Hz, with 32 GB RAM, 512GB SSD and 1 TB storage capacity for storing generated images and data. c. Inbuilt UPS for workstation, power backup not less than 30 mins, must be included. d. The unit must be supplied servo-controlled voltage stabilizer. 9. Certifications a. The system should have AERB/US FDA/ European CE certificate or equivalent must to be provided. b. Manufacturer must have BIS, CDSCO, ISO 13485:2016 or IEC certification. c. User/Technical/Maintenance manuals to be supplied in English 10. Warranty and service support a. The system should be supplied with a minimum of 3-year onsite warranty with 2-year of comprehensi ve warranty. b. Must provide QA reports IQ, PQ, & OQ and QC reports as per standards. User/Technical/Maintenance manual to be supplied in both hard and soft copy. c. Supplier must have an established service network with Toll-Free support. d. Local service representative must be available and breakdown response time must be within 48 hours . e. Comprehensive training for lab staff and support services till familiarity with the system. Mechanical motion specifications (C-Arm) a. Motorized vertical travel should be 400 mm or more. b. Pivotal rotation / swivel range should be ±12.5° or more. c. Arc orbital movement should be 120° (−30° to +90°) or better. d. Horizontal movement should be 200 mm or more. e. Source-to-Image Intensifier distance (SID) should be 960 mm or more. f. Free space between image intensifier and X-ray tube should be 760 mm or more. g. Rotation of C-Arm should be ±180° or more. h. Arc depth of C-Arm should be 630 mm or more. i. The C-Arm should have a foot lock facility. j. Mechanical locks for all movements must be provided. 3. X-ray generator and control panel a. The X-ray generator should be a high-frequency generator of minimum b. 50 kHz or more. c. Generator power output should be 3.5 kW or more. d. Operating voltage range should be 40 kV to 110 kV. e. Continuous fluoroscopy current range should be 0.1 to 3 mA. f. The X-ray tube should have focal spots minimum of 0.6 mm² for fluoroscopy and 1.5 mm² for radiogra phy. g. Anode heat storage capacity should be 40 KHU or more. h. Boosted / High-definition fluoroscopy current should be of minimum 7.0 mA or more. i. Console should display real-time tube head temperature with bar graph indicator. j. Radiography capacity should be 200 mAs or more. k. Radiography mA should be 70 mA or more. l. X-ray exposure initiation should be possible through both foot switch and hand-held switch. m. Unit must have a 7-inch or higher full touch digital GUI control panel. n. Manual and automatic (KV/mA) selection modes must be available.

o. All fluoroscopic and radiographic parameters including KV, mA, time, mode, magnification, and tube te mperature should be displayed on the panel. p. Unit must have cumulative timer (~5 min) with buzzer should be provided. q. Emergency stop switch must be provided. r. Anatomical program radiography modes should be included. s. The X-ray generator should be of indigenous make if the generator is imported from other country, co mplete specifications of datasheet from the principal manufacture with an undertaking from them stati ng spares/parts of the generator would be available for the next 10 years to be attached with the bid. 4. Imaging system (Image intensifier & camera) a. Image intensifier should be a triple-field of 9”/6”/4.5”. b. X-ray grid shall be 10:1, 100 lines. c. TV camera should be a compact CMOS/CCD type with 1024 × 1024 pixels or more. d. Modular trolley should include a minimum of 27-inch single monitor/dual screen monitor of minimum 1 9-inch. e. System should support image rotation without exposure. 5. Digital imaging and processing features a. System should include a PC-based full digital image memory module. b. Subject registration should include subject details, procedure details, doctor name, date and time. c. Display information should include subject ID, name, age, hospital name, operating modes, rotation an d KV/mA in values. d. Real-time brightness and contrast adjustment should be available. e. Last Image Hold - should hold the last image on the screen after every procedure during fluoroscopy a nd have sequential numbering. f. Virtual Collimation - Alignment and adjustment of X-ray field with image available on the monitor. g. Permanent image storage capacity should be 2,00,000 images or more. h.
